_doc: Traits of race wave 1. Each is a bag of keys of the trait library (data/traits.json `_doc`). Work speeds are factors on speed (2 = twice as fast); where the race spec gives a repair TIME factor (as Fenn's x0.6) the speed is its inverse.

swarm.name: Hive-minded
swarm.blurb: Works harder beside the hive: +25% work speed per other Kett in the room, at most +50%.

firefighter.name: Firefighter
firefighter.blurb: Shipboard firefighters by tradition: puts fires out twice as fast and takes half the burn.

dries_out.name: Dries out
dries_out.blurb: Loses 2 hp a second in a room whose hottest part is above 60.

aura_spores.name: Spore cloud
aura_spores.blurb: Their room gains half a cell of air a second each (a Garden Bay's worth) and everyone in it heals 1 hp a second.

flammable.name: Flammable
flammable.blurb: Burns half as hard again: fire damage x1.5.

mechanical.name: Mechanical
mechanical.blurb: Half the body is machine: beds do nothing, but a crewmate with a spanner mends them.

ion_prone.name: Ion-prone
ion_prone.blurb: An ion hit on their room stuns them for 3 seconds.

crystal_conduit.name: Crystal conduit
crystal_conduit.blurb: The system they man gets +1 power while they man it.

crystal_body.name: Crystal body
crystal_body.blurb: Takes double ion damage, and hits half as hard in a brawl.

hauler.name: Hauler
hauler.blurb: Moves cargo twice as fast and hits twice as hard in a brawl.

clumsy.name: Clumsy
clumsy.blurb: Big hands on small work: repairs and breach patches take x1.3 the time.
